evidence.detail: The exact-v308 record stores an event type, secondary button/code integer, current x/y coordinates, min/max x/y bounds and a timestamp.
When consecutive type-3 movement arrives, the queue updates the latest record's current x/y/time and expands its min/max coordinate bounds instead of appending another record.
rs/Client.by() consumes these fields after draining the queue, using event type, button/code, coordinates, movement bounds and timestamp in the client input loop.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 owns a fixed 256-record ring with synchronized append, drain and reset operations plus an overflow counter; a full queue is reset through an inserted type-4 boundary marker.

The base client input host rs/C feeds pointer press/release/motion and related client input events into this queue with coordinates and event timestamps; consecutive type-3 motion records are coalesced in place.
rs/Client.by() drains this queue into a preallocated record array and dispatches event types 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 through the client input state and interaction paths.
